The goal of this file is to import worksheets from Survey123 and make RData files to use in the Processing script.

Starting in 2025, removed all script used to process continuous data files. Remnants are found in 2024 and earlier versions. This removal streamlines and clarifies procedures.

Import the Calibration Worksheets and their crosswalk (these were generated using the first version of the CDFW Survey123 e-forms)
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
rm(list = ls())
'%ni%' = Negate('%in%')
cw_Calib <- data.frame(read.csv(here::here("raw","Survey123","Calibrations_v240206", "Calibration240602_ColumnCrosswalk.csv")))
#df_Calib <- data.frame(read.csv(here::here("raw","Survey123", "Calibrations_v230612", "Calibration230612_Export230706.csv"))) # this is for an older version now stored in the 'archive' folder
#df_Calib <- data.frame(read.csv(here::here("raw","Survey123", "Calibrations_v230612", "Calibration230612_Export240206.csv")))# this is for an older version now stored in the 'archive' folder
df_Calib <- data.frame(read.csv(here::here("raw","Survey123", "Calibrations_v240206", "Calibration_240206_Export20260724.csv")))

colnames(df_Calib) <- cw_Calib$Var_Name

# fill missing deployment times by using values from the calibration time  - ALM
df_Calib <- df_Calib %>% mutate(dts_startstop = ifelse(deployment_startstop_time %in% "", calibration_date_and_time, deployment_startstop_time))

# make a datetime object for the deployment start/stop time and the calibration time   
df_Calib$dts_startstop <- format(lubridate::mdy_hms(df_Calib$dts_startstop), tz = "America/Los_Angeles")

# insert borrowed sonde ID into sonde_id column for 10/27 & 10/29
df_Calib$sonde_id <- ifelse(df_Calib$sonde_id=="other", df_Calib$sonde_other, df_Calib$sonde_id)

# Fill in missing standard values
# add in zero standard for fluorescent parameters that were checked and not calibrated (due to reading within limits)
df_Calib$fdom_zero_post_rfu <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$fdom_zero_post_rfu)& !is.na(df_Calib$fdom_zero_pre_rfu), 0, df_Calib$fdom_zero_post_rfu)
df_Calib$chl_zero_post_rfu <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$chl_zero_post_rfu)& !is.na(df_Calib$chl_zero_pre_rfu), 0, df_Calib$chl_zero_post_rfu)
df_Calib$pc_zero_post_rfu <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$pc_zero_post_rfu)& !is.na(df_Calib$pc_zero_pre_rfu), 0, df_Calib$pc_zero_post_rfu)

# add in standard value for SpCnd that went through a postcal
df_Calib[c('spc_std1','spc_std2')] <- str_split_fixed(df_Calib$spc_1412, '_', 2) #pull out standard concentrations
df_Calib$spc_std2 <- as.numeric(df_Calib$spc_std2) #change format to numeric
df_Calib$spc_conc <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$spc_conc), df_Calib$spc_std2, df_Calib$spc_conc) #fill spc_conc column with standard concentrations
df_Calib$spc_conc <- ifelse(df_Calib$Notes%in%"Re-Cal SPC 10,000 to1412 standard", 1412, df_Calib$spc_conc) # fill remaining standard concentrations from Notes
# Fill NAs in pre and post columns with the standard value for calculating difference (aka calibration drift)
df_Calib$sc_high_post <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$sc_high_post)& !is.na(df_Calib$sc_high_pre), df_Calib$spc_conc, df_Calib$sc_high_post)
df_Calib$sc_high_pre <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$sc_high_pre)& !is.na(df_Calib$sc_high_post), df_Calib$spc_conc, df_Calib$sc_high_pre)

# add in pH standard values for pH that went through a postcal with no notes on poor readings
df_Calib$pH_7_post <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$pH_7_post)& !is.na(df_Calib$pH_7_pre), 7, df_Calib$pH_7_post)
df_Calib$pH_10_post <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$pH_10_post)& !is.na(df_Calib$pH_10_pre), 10, df_Calib$pH_10_post)
df_Calib$pH_4_post <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$pH_4_post)& !is.na(df_Calib$pH_4_pre), 4, df_Calib$pH_4_post)

#add in turb standard values for turb that went through a postcal with  no notes on poor readings
df_Calib$turb_high_post <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$turb_high_post)& !is.na(df_Calib$turb_high_pre), 124, df_Calib$turb_high_post)
df_Calib$turb_high_pre <- ifelse(!is.na(df_Calib$turb_high_post)& is.na(df_Calib$turb_high_pre), 124, df_Calib$turb_high_pre)
df_Calib$turb_zero_post <- ifelse(is.na(df_Calib$turb_zero_post)& !is.na(df_Calib$turb_zero_pre), 0, df_Calib$turb_zero_post)
df_Calib$turb_zero_pre <- ifelse(!is.na(df_Calib$turb_zero_post)& is.na(df_Calib$turb_zero_pre), 0, df_Calib$turb_zero_pre)

# make 2 separate dataframes (1 with just the data we are interested and 1 with the metadata)
df_CalibData <- df_Calib[,c("GlobalID","sonde_id","sonde_other","discrete_or_continuous","pre_post","dts_startstop",colnames(df_Calib)[53:107])]
df_CalibMeta <- df_Calib[,c("GlobalID","sonde_id","sonde_other","discrete_or_continuous","pre_post","dts_startstop",colnames(df_Calib)[c(7:52,109:114)])]

save(df_Calib, df_CalibData, df_CalibMeta, file = here::here("working","Processing_2025","CDFW_CalibrationWorksheet.RData"))
```
